ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; over 90% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity dark pixels, with high-intensity white pixels restricted to distal tips and localized specular reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous region of dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters are localized at the extreme lateral tips. Scattered mid-to-high intensity specular highlights are visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; the interior angle is approximately 45 degrees with a significant vertical depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary characterized by non-uniform peaks and valleys; higher frequency of small-scale jaggedness is detected on the medial sections near the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature following an upward and outward trajectory from the center toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups located at the lateral tips of both lobes; sparse individual white circular markers are scattered across the lower ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white calcareous-intensity clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral edges of both the left and right fluke lobes.
